# Workitem 02 — Plan Future Week Bundles

## Purpose

Create a week-based migration plan for later ML topics without creating empty future folders.

## Scope

- Map future topics to likely `src/weekN/` bundles.
- Keep the plan high level until Swamy starts a week.
- Leave preserved archive folders unchanged.

## Candidate Topics

- Linear regression
- Logistic regression
- Support vector machines
- Decision trees and random forests
- K-means clustering
- Hierarchical clustering
- Principal component analysis
- Semi-supervised learning
- Reinforcement learning foundations

## Acceptance Criteria

- The plan uses only the active four-layer model.
- The plan does not imply this repo is for a general audience.
- No empty `src/weekN/` scaffolding is created before the week starts.
- Public docs remain aligned with `docs/01_repository-structure.md`.
